verses.en: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
verses.pt: Pois, como a Lei tem uma sombra dos bens futuros, e não a própria imagem das coisas, ela nunca pode, por meio dos mesmos sacrifícios que se oferecem a cada ano, continuamente, tornar perfeitos os que se aproximam.
verses.en_web: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.
verses.en_bbe: For the law, being only a poor copy of the future good things, and not the true image of those things, is never able to make the people who come to the altar every year with the same offerings completely clean.

verses.en: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
verses.pt: Caso contrário, deixariam de ser oferecidos, pois os adoradores, uma vez purificados, não teriam mais consciência alguma de pecados.
verses.en_web: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?
verses.en_bbe: For if this had been possible, would there not have been an end of those offerings, because the worshippers would have been made completely clean and would have been no longer conscious of sins?

verses.en: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
verses.pt: Porém nesses sacrifícios a cada ano se faz uma nova lembrança dos pecados,
verses.en_web: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.
verses.en_bbe: But year by year there is a memory of sins in those offerings.

verses.en: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
verses.pt: porque é impossível que o sangue de touros e de bodes tire pecados.
verses.en_web: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.
verses.en_bbe: Because it is not possible for the blood of oxen and goats to take away sins.

verses.en: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
verses.pt: Por isso que, quando ele entrou no mundo, disse: Sacrifício e oferta não quiseste, mas me preparaste um corpo.
verses.en_web: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire, but you prepared a body for me.
verses.en_bbe: So that when he comes into the world, he says, You had no desire for offerings, but you made a body ready for me;

verses.en: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.
verses.pt: Ofertas de queima e ofertas pelo pecado não te agradaram.
verses.en_web: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.
verses.en_bbe: You had no joy in burned offerings or in offerings for sin.

verses.en: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
verses.pt: Então eu disse: “Eis-me aqui; (no rolo do livro está escrito de mim) venho para fazer a tua vontade, ó Deus”. Salmos 40:6-8
verses.en_web: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”
verses.en_bbe: Then I said, See, I have come to do your pleasure, O God (as it is said of me in the roll of the book).

verses.en: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
verses.pt: Depois de ter dito acima: “Sacrifício, oferta, holocaustos, e ofertas pelo pecado não quiseste, nem te agradaram”, (os quais se oferecem segundo a Lei),
verses.en_web: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),
verses.en_bbe: After saying, You had no desire for offerings, for burned offerings or offerings for sin (which are made by the law) and you had no pleasure in them,

verses.en: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
verses.pt: então disse: “Eis-me aqui, venho para fazer a tua vontade, ó Deus”. Assim, ele cancela o primeiro pacto,para estabelecer o segundo.
verses.en_web: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,
verses.en_bbe: Then he said, See, I have come to do your pleasure. He took away the old order, so that he might put the new order in its place.

verses.en: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
verses.pt: Pela sua vontade somos santificados por meio da oferta sacrificial do corpo de Jesus Cristo, feita de uma vez por todas.
verses.en_web: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
verses.en_bbe: By that pleasure we have been made holy, by the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once and for ever.

verses.en: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
verses.pt: Todo sacerdote comparece a cada dia para servir e oferecer muitas vezes os mesmos sacrifícios, que nunca podem tirar os pecados;
verses.en_web: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and often offering the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,
verses.en_bbe: And every priest takes his place at the altar day by day, doing what is necessary, and making again and again the same offerings which are never able to take away sins.

verses.en: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
verses.pt: Mas Jesus,depois que ofereceu um sacrifício pelos pecados, assentou-se para sempre à direita de Deus;
verses.en_web: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God;
verses.en_bbe: But when Jesus had made one offering for sins for ever, he took his place at the right hand of God;

verses.en: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
verses.pt: e espera desde então, até que os seus inimigos sejam postos por escabelo dos seus pés.
verses.en_web: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.
verses.en_bbe: And has been waiting there from that time, till all who are against him are made a foot-rest for his feet.

verses.en: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
verses.pt: Pois com uma só oferta ele aperfeiçoou para sempre os que são santificados.
verses.en_web: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.
verses.en_bbe: Because by one offering he has made complete for ever those who are made holy.

verses.en: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
verses.pt: E também o Espírito Santo nos dá testemunho acerca disso; pois, depois de haver anteriormente dito:
verses.en_web: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Holy Spirit is a witness for us: for after he had said,

verses.en: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
verses.pt: Este é o pacto que farei com eles depois daqueles dias, diz o Senhor: Porei minhas leis em seus corações, e as escreverei em suas mentes; Jeremias 31:33
verses.en_web: “This is the covenant that I will make with them: ‘After those days,’ says the Lord, ‘I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;’” then he says,
verses.en_bbe: This is the agreement which I will make with them after those days, says the Lord; I will put my laws in their hearts, writing them in their minds; he said,

verses.en: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.pt: Então ele diz: E não mais me lembrarei dos seus pecados e das suas transgressões. Jeremias 31:34
verses.en_web: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”
verses.en_bbe: And I will keep no more memory of their sins and of their evil-doings.

verses.en: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
verses.pt: Ora, onde há perdão dessas coisas, não há mais oferta pelo pecado.
verses.en_web: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
verses.en_bbe: Now where there is forgiveness of these, there is no more offering for sin.

verses.en: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
verses.pt: Portanto, irmãos, já que temos a confiança de entrar no Santuário pelo sangue de Jesus,
verses.en_web: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
verses.en_bbe: So then, my brothers, being able to go into the holy place without fear, because of the blood of Jesus,

verses.en: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
verses.pt: pelo caminho novo e vivo que ele consagrou para nós através do véu, isto é, pela sua carne;
verses.en_web: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
verses.en_bbe: By the new and living way which he made open for us through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

verses.en: And having an high priest over the house of God;
verses.pt: e já que temos um grande Sacerdote sobre a casa de Deus,
verses.en_web: and having a great priest over God’s house,
verses.en_bbe: And having a great priest over the house of God,

verses.en: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
verses.pt: aproximemo-nos com um coração sincero em plena certeza de fé, tendo os corações aspergidos e purificados da má consciência, e o corpo lavado com água pura;
verses.en_web: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and having our body washed with pure water,
verses.en_bbe: Let us go in with true hearts, in certain faith, having our hearts made free from the sense of sin and our bodies washed with clean water:

verses.en: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
verses.pt: mantenhamos firme a esperança que declararmos ter, sem abalo algum, pois aquele que prometeu é fiel;
verses.en_web: let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.
verses.en_bbe: Let us keep the witness of our hope strong and unshaking, for he is true who has given his word:

verses.en: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
verses.pt: e sejamos atenciosos uns para com os outros, a fim de incentivar o amor e as boas obras;
verses.en_web: Let us consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,
verses.en_bbe: And let us be moving one another at all times to love and good works;

verses.en: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
verses.pt: não abandonando a nossa reunião, como é o costume de alguns. Ao contrário, encorajemos uns aos outros, e tanto mais quanto vedes aquele dia se aproximando.
verses.en_web: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another; and so much the more, as you see the Day approaching.
verses.en_bbe: Not giving up our meetings, as is the way of some, but keeping one another strong in faith; and all the more because you see the day coming near.

verses.en: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
verses.pt: Pois se nós, depois de havermos recebido o conhecimento da verdade, persistirmos pecando por vontade própria, já não resta mais sacrifício pelos pecados;
verses.en_web: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,
verses.en_bbe: For if we do evil on purpose after we have had the knowledge of what is true, there is no more offering for sins,

verses.en: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
verses.pt: em vez disso, certa terrível expectativa de julgamento, e um fogo de indignação que consumirá os adversários.
verses.en_web: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.
verses.en_bbe: But only a great fear of being judged, and of the fire of wrath which will be the destruction of the haters of God.

verses.en: He that despised Moses’ law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
verses.pt: Se alguém que rejeita a Lei de Moisés morre sem misericórdia com base na palavra de duas ou três testemunhas,
verses.en_web: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
verses.en_bbe: A man who has gone against the law of Moses is put to death without pity on the word of two or three witnesses:

verses.en: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
verses.pt: de quanto pior castigo vós pensais que será julgado merecedor aquele que pisou o Filho de Deus, menosprezou ) o sangue do Testamento no qual ele foi santificado, e insultou o Espírito da graça?
verses.en_web: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?
verses.en_bbe: But will not the man by whom the Son of God has been crushed under foot, and the blood of the agreement with which he was washed clean has been taken as an unholy thing, and who has had no respect for the Spirit of grace, be judged bad enough for a very much worse punishment?

verses.en: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
verses.pt: Pois nós conhecemos aquele que disse: A vingança é minha; eu retribuirei, diz o Senhor. E outra vez: O Senhor julgará o seu povo. Deuteronômio 32:35,36
verses.en_web: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me,” says the Lord, “I will repay.” Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”
verses.en_bbe: For we have had experience of him who says, Punishment is mine, I will give reward. And again, The Lord will be judge of his people.

verses.en: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.pt: Cair nas mãos do Deus vivo é algo terrível.
verses.en_web: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
verses.en_bbe: We may well go in fear of falling into the hands of the living God.

verses.en: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
verses.pt: Lembrai-vos, porém, dos dias passados, em que, depois de serdes iluminados, suportastes grande combate de aflições,
verses.en_web: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings;
verses.en_bbe: But give thought to the days after you had seen the light, when you went through a great war of troubles;

verses.en: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
verses.pt: quando, em parte, fostes expostos em público tanto a insultos, como a tribulações, e em parte, fostes companheiros daqueles que assim foram tratados.
verses.en_web: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions; and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.
verses.en_bbe: In part, in being attacked by angry words and cruel acts, before the eyes of everyone, and in part, in being united with those who were attacked in this way.

verses.en: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
verses.pt: Pois também vos compadecestes das minhas prisões, e com alegria aceitastes a espoliação dos vossos bens, pois sabeis em vós mesmos que tendes nos Céus um bem melhor e permanente.
verses.en_web: For you both had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.
verses.en_bbe: For you had pity on those who were in prison, and had joy in the loss of your property, in the knowledge that you still had a better property and one which you would keep for ever.

verses.en: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
verses.pt: Portanto, não rejeiteis a vossa confiança, que tem uma grande recompensa;
verses.en_web: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
verses.en_bbe: So do not give up your hope which will be greatly rewarded.

verses.en: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
verses.pt: pois precisais de paciência, a fim de que, depois que houverdes feito a vontade de Deus, recebais o que foi prometido.
verses.en_web: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
verses.en_bbe: For, having done what was right in God's eyes, you have need of waiting before his word has effect for you.

verses.en: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
verses.pt: Pois ainda um pouquinho de tempo, e aquele que vem virá, e não tardará. Isaías 26:20, Habacuque 2:3
verses.en_web: “In a very little while, he who comes will come, and will not wait.
verses.en_bbe: In a very little time he who is coming will come; he will not be slow.

verses.en: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
verses.pt: Mas o justo viverá pela fé; e se ele retroceder, a minha alma não tem prazer nele. Habacuque 2:4
verses.en_web: But the righteous will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
verses.en_bbe: But the upright man will be living by his faith; and if he goes back, my soul will have no pleasure in him.

verses.en: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
verses.pt: Mas nós não somos dos que retrocedem para a perdição, mas sim dos que creem para a conservação da alma.
verses.en_web: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
verses.en_bbe: But we are not of those who go back to destruction; but of those who have faith even to the salvation of the soul.
